manifestHashPolicy: Every payload file uses SHA-256 of its exact bytes. EXPORT_MANIFEST.json uses SHA-256 of its exact UTF-8 bytes after replacing only its own files[].sha256 value with 64 ASCII zeroes; this normalization avoids an impossible self-referential byte digest. The final ZIP digest covers the exact manifest bytes.

knownBlockers: No conforming OIDC/OAuth authorization server; cannot replace Keycloak issuer, browser protocol, or service-client administration.
No TOTP, recovery codes, WebAuthn, password reset, email verification, SMTP delivery, or English/Turkish/French/Portuguese identity catalogs.
No organization membership or tenant isolation model.
No disabled, suspended, or locked account enforcement; deletion-pending is not checked by authentication.
No login/registration rate limits, constant-cost unknown-user path, password strength/history, or rehash policy.
Password change leaves the current pre-change refresh family usable.
Security audit coverage and failure handling are incomplete.
Source authorization includes applicant-gate, scoped-permission, and role-read defects.
PostgreSQL integration, migration execution, and refresh concurrency were not verified.
Dependency advisories remain because source versions were preserved for evaluation.
Source redistribution and integration licensing were not established.
